metadata.name: darkseek_vault
metadata.description: DarkSeek vault program: player vaults, room escrow and settlement, the fee split, $DS staking, buyback and vesting

instructions.name: abort_stale_round
docs: Anyone may unwind a round that made no progress for two hours: a lobby
nobody joined or left (full refunds) or a live round never settled
(refunds less the fee).

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step: the proposed key signs to take the admin role.

instructions.name: cancel_round
docs: The game server gives up on a round. Before the start every stake goes
back in full; after it, less the fee already taken. The remaining
accounts are the seated players' vaults, in slot order.

instructions.name: charge
docs: The owner pays the protocol from their vault (a shop purchase).

instructions.name: claim_rebate
docs: Turns a vault's rebate credit into $DS at the average price the rebate
pool paid for the $DS in the reserve, as far as the reserve reaches; the
rest waits for the auction's next purchases. Anyone may call it: the $DS
can only land in that vault.

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Moves a vault's USDC staking rewards into its free balance.

instructions.name: claim_vesting
docs: Releases what has vested so far to the beneficiary's token account.

instructions.name: create_vesting
docs: Locks `total` tokens of any mint (SPL Token or Token 2022) for
`beneficiary`: nothing before `cliff`, then a straight line from `start`
to `end`. Anyone may lock their own tokens this way; nobody can revoke
a lock or speed it up.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Moves USDC from the signer's token account into `vault` (own or anyone's).

instructions.name: deposit_ds
docs: Moves $DS from the signer's token account into `vault` (own or anyone's).

instructions.name: init_ds
docs: Records the $DS mint, the buyback target and the auction's parameters,
once. The mint, SPL Token or Token 2022, must have a fixed supply (no mint
authority, no freeze authority), six decimals and no extension but
metadata. Nothing recorded here can change later.

instructions.name: init_room
docs: Creates room `index` (1 to 6) with a fixed tier (0 casual, 1 pro).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config and the USDC custody. Only the program's upgrade
authority may call it, once. Stakes, fee and split are fixed from here on.

accounts.name: admin
docs: must be the program's upgrade authority

instructions.name: lock_stake
docs: Puts the stake for `slot` (0 and 1 Seekers, 2 to 9 Hiders) into the room.
Needs the player's session and counts toward its daily cap.

instructions.name: open_vault
docs: Creates `owner`'s vault. Anyone may pay for it; the owner need not sign.

instructions.name: pay
docs: The owner pays another player's vault (a P2P purchase).

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of handing the admin role over (to a multisig, say). The
default key cancels a pending proposal.

instructions.name: sell_ds
docs: Sells up to `max_ds` $DS to the program at the current auction price,
for at least `min_usdc`. The program pays from the rebate pool at any
time, and from the buyback pool only in buyback rounds: a round opens once
the pool holds the whole target and spends exactly the target. $DS bought
for the buyback is burned here and now; $DS bought for rebates joins the
reserve. When a round's budget is spent, the next target is 98% of this
one. The price then restarts at 1.5 times this fill.

accounts.name: ds_mint
docs: burning lowers the supply recorded in the mint

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Replaces the game server's key.

instructions.name: set_session
docs: The owner lets the game server lock room stakes for them until
`expires_at`, at most `daily_cap` a day. A past `expires_at` revokes it.

instructions.name: settle_round
docs: Pays the round out by the rules. `outcomes[i]` is Hider slot 2 + i:
`SURVIVED`, or the Seeker slot (0 or 1) that caught it. The remaining
accounts are the ten seated players' vaults, in slot order.

instructions.name: stake_ds
docs: Stakes free $DS from the vault. Stakers share 10% of every fee (1% of
every stake) in USDC, pro rata to stake, from the next round that starts.

instructions.name: start_round
docs: All ten seats are staked: the round goes live, the fee is taken seat by
seat and split by the fixed shares.

instructions.name: sweep_treasury
docs: The admin takes protocol revenue out of the treasury, and nothing else.

instructions.name: unlock_stake
docs: Someone left before the round started: their whole stake goes back.

instructions.name: unstake_ds
docs: Unstakes $DS back to the vault's free balance. No lockup.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: The owner takes free USDC out. Needs nothing from the game server.

instructions.name: withdraw_ds
docs: The owner takes free $DS (rebates, deposits, unstaked) out of their vault.

types.name: Auction
docs: The descending price auction that turns the buyback and rebate pools into $DS.
Prices are in $DS base units per whole USDC: a higher price means the program
asks for more $DS for each USDC it pays out.

fields.name: last_price
docs: price of the last fill (the genesis price until the first fill)

fields.name: started_at
docs: when the current descent began: the last fill, or `init_ds`

fields.name: floor_price
docs: lowest price the auction ever asks, so the most USDC paid per $DS

fields.name: duration
docs: seconds from the start price down to the floor

fields.name: lot
docs: most USDC a single fill may take

fields.name: min_fill
docs: least USDC a single fill must take, unless it takes all that is on offer

types.name: Buyback
docs: One fill of the $DS auction.

fields.name: price
docs: $DS base units per whole USDC

fields.name: buyback_target
docs: the target after this fill: lower by 2% each time a round completes

fields.name: buyback_round_left
docs: USDC left in the open buyback round (0: none open)

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: set by `propose_admin`, takes over on `accept_admin`

fields.name: authority
docs: the game server's key

fields.name: mint
docs: the stake token (USDC)

fields.name: ds_mint
docs: $DS, recorded once by `init_ds`, with the token program that owns it

fields.name: stakes
docs: [casual Hider, casual Seeker, pro Hider, pro Seeker] in base units

fields.name: buyback_target
docs: USDC a buyback round spends: set once by `init_ds`, then only lowered by 2% per completed round

fields.name: buyback_target_initial
docs: the target `init_ds` set; target n is this times 0.98^n, rounded down each time

fields.name: buybacks_done
docs: completed buyback rounds

fields.name: buyback_round_left
docs: USDC left to spend in the open buyback round (0: none open)

fields.name: ds_reserve
docs: $DS the rebate pool bought and nobody has claimed yet

fields.name: reserve_cost
docs: USDC the rebate pool paid for `ds_reserve`

fields.name: rebate_credits
docs: USDC of rebates credited to vaults and not yet turned into $DS

fields.name: reward_per_ds
docs: USDC per staked $DS base unit, scaled by `REWARD_SCALE`

fields.name: reward_carry
docs: stakers' USDC not yet in the accumulator (nobody staked, or rounding), scaled by `REWARD_SCALE`

fields.name: genesis_price
docs: reference price until the first fill, in $DS base units per whole USDC

fields.name: buyback_target
docs: USDC the first buyback round spends (half the USDC value of the launch buy)

fields.name: buyback_target
docs: USDC the first buyback round spends; each later round spends 98% of the one before

types.name: FeeSplitBps
docs: How the protocol fee is shared, in basis points of the fee. The four parts
must add up to 10 000; the treasury also takes any rounding remainder, so
the parts of every fee add up to the fee exactly.

fields.name: stakers
docs: $DS stakers, paid in USDC pro rata to stake

fields.name: rebate
docs: players who lost money in the round, paid in $DS

fields.name: buyback
docs: buys $DS in the auction and burns it

fields.name: treasury
docs: protocol treasury

fields.name: authority
docs: the game server's key

fields.name: stakes
docs: [casual Hider, casual Seeker, pro Hider, pro Seeker] in base units

types.name: RebateClaimed
docs: Rebate credit turned into $DS at the reserve's average purchase cost.

fields.name: tier
docs: 0 casual, 1 pro

fields.name: pot
docs: USDC in escrow for this round (net of the fee once live)

fields.name: fee
docs: fee taken when the round started

fields.name: rebate
docs: the part of the fee owed to this round's losers, credited at settlement

fields.name: updated_at
docs: last lock, unlock or start

types.name: RoundRefunded
docs: Stakes went back without a result: in full before the start, less the fee after it.

fields.name: rebate_usdc
docs: after the start every seat lost the fee, so each is credited a share of the rebate

fields.name: losers
docs: bit `slot` set: that seat lost money this round

fields.name: rebate_usdc
docs: USDC of rebate credited to each losing seat, paid in $DS by `claim_rebate`

fields.name: dust
docs: rounding dust from the pot, added to the treasury

types.name: RoundStarted
docs: The fee was taken and split when the round went live.

types.name: Totals
docs: Running totals since initialization, so anyone can check the books from one account.

fields.name: staked
docs: gross stakes of every round that started

fields.name: buyback_spent
docs: USDC paid out of the buyback pool by the auction

fields.name: rebate_spent
docs: USDC paid out of the rebate pool by the auction

fields.name: ds_to_reserve
docs: $DS the rebate pool bought into the reserve

fields.name: rebates_credited
docs: USDC of rebates credited to players who lost money

fields.name: rebates_claimed
docs: USDC of rebate credits turned into $DS

fields.name: ds_rebated
docs: $DS paid out of the reserve for those credits

fields.name: balance
docs: USDC free to withdraw, stake in a room or spend

fields.name: locked
docs: USDC in rooms right now

fields.name: session_expires
docs: the game server may lock room stakes until then

fields.name: daily_cap
docs: most USDC the game server may lock in a day

fields.name: ds_balance
docs: $DS free to withdraw or stake

fields.name: reward_index
docs: accumulator value at the last reward sync

fields.name: rewards
docs: USDC staking rewards synced but not yet claimed

fields.name: rebate_credit
docs: USDC of rebates owed to this vault, paid in $DS by `claim_rebate`

types.name: Vesting
docs: Tokens locked for one beneficiary, released linearly between `start` and
`end`, nothing before `cliff`. Nobody can revoke it or release it early.
